method: Mutual SIFT .72 + independent two-view F screening; fixed VGGT camera/depth projection, no fitting to the correspondences

thresholds.confidence_cut: 40th percentile per image, not a calibrated confidence probability

generation: Exactly two new builtin image_gen outputs, no hand retouching or old image edits.
camera_intent_note: A/B pose values were prompt instructions, not numeric camera control. B remained mostly outside the door.
door_state_note: Original/A show a closed leaf; approach/B show an open leaf. The leaf and view-dependent glazing are not rigid-scene truth.

limitations: VGGT can assign poses even to incompatible generated images; pose output is not success.
A conflict may come from generated geometry, wrong descriptor matches, glass/reflections or VGGT estimation error.
Low overlap is unverified evidence, not proof of inconsistency.
Independent F screening can miss along-epipolar-line edits; repeated objects can still mismatch.
Confidence values are not calibrated correctness probabilities.
No genuine novel-view photos, measured dimensions or depth truth exist for this AI image.
New generated textures may increase match counts without preserving doorframe/counter topology.
Adding frames changes VGGT context, so before/after prediction differences alone do not prove better images.
The new images are not independently captured spatial evidence.
